title: The Bell of Eternity
description: A colossal dark castle shaped like a hooded giant extends its massive stone hand over a reflective green lake. A giant metal bell hangs from a chain above the castle while a black hole and swirling purple galaxy dominate the blood-red sky. A robed figure in purple stands on an orange boat-like platform, surrounded by large glowing green orbs containing silhouetted figures.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of a colossal stone giant wearing a gothic cathedral as a crown, extending its enormous hand over a reflective emerald lake. A massive iron bell hangs above the structure. A lone purple-robed figure stands on an orange boat in the foreground. The sky is blood red with a large black hole and a swirling purple galaxy. Glowing green orbs with silhouetted human figures float in the water and air, dramatic cinematic lighting.
